context.body: The bounded canonical source is Exodus 32:15–35; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Moses breaks the tablets, destroys the calf, confronts Aaron, and the Levites kill within the camp.
observations.label: Broken tablets, violence, and intercession follow the calf: action

observations.body: Moses then seeks atonement and offers himself, but the LORD distinguishes the sinner and sends a plague.
observations.label: Broken tablets, violence, and intercession follow the calf: response

payload.posture: Read Exodus 32:15–35 as covenant at the mountain evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Covenant breach, internal violence, mediated appeal, individual accountability, and collective consequence remain in one difficult aftermath.
